breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated and followed the flawed instruction, computing an arithmetic mean area (300 mm²) and using the constant-area formula δ = P·L/(A_mean·E). The ground truth requires evaluating the exact integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)·E) dx with the spatially varying A(x). The agent did not resolve this inconsistency and instead reinforced the incorrect approach.
